sources: Eminent Repute. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_sword_0013 and Json/BuffData buff_wpn_sword_0013_atk_up (game 1.6); values SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_sword_0013 (level 9: atk_up 0.28, atk_up_add 0.14, atk_up_mult 0.07, duration 20). Skills 1–2 (main attribute, Physical DMG) and skill 3's ATK + atk_up (cardAttributeModifier attribute 2) are on the stat panel.

passiveEventActions abilityEvent 208 (the wielder consumes a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 tag 1075718177 (Vulnerable) + CheckConsumeBuffLayer ≥ 1 (consume_layer) → atk_up_ex = atk_up_mult × consume_layer + atk_up_add → CreateBuff buff_wpn_sword_0013_atk_up on the wielder (attribute 2 formulaItem 6: ATK + atk_up_ex, `duration`); then atk_up_ex × 0.5 (base_atk_up literal) → the same buff on the team (CharacterTeamFinder). The game buff is stackingType 1 with priority key atk_up_ex and maxStackCnt 2: the loader keeps up to two instances per recipient and only the strongest acts (batch-3 B1), so the wielder's full-strength one wins over its half. As Ancient Canal (wpn_claym_0014). Description: "After the wielder consumes Vulnerability stack(s), the wielder gains ATK +[{atk_up_add} + {atk_up_mult}×Stacks Consumed] while other operators in the team gain half of this buff for {duration}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack."

Crush and Breach are what consume Vulnerable (status.ts); the event's level is the stacks consumed (eventCount). beforeDamage: abilityEvent 208 comes from the status buff's FinishBuff of Vulnerable, before its DamageAction (in-game test 51, Da Pan part). toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01: the template leftover (batch 1). Rossi consumes no Vulnerable; natural wielders are Pogranichnik (Breach) and the Endministrator (Crush). Not in any log.

buffs.label: Eminent Repute: ATK (wielder)
buffs.note: Its value is taken at the event: 0.14 + 0.07 × stacks consumed at level 9 (0.42 after a 4-stack Crush).

buffs.label: Eminent Repute: ATK (other operators, half)
buffs.note: 0.5: the skill's SimpleCalc literal (ModifyDynamicBlackboard atk_up_ex × 0.5, base_atk_up not read from the blackboard). The wielder is left out: its own instance is stronger and the same game buff (only the strongest acts).
